name: Brksoft – N11 için Entegrasyon
author: Brksoft

sections.description:
Brksoft – N11 için Entegrasyon allows you to synchronize stock and price information between your WooCommerce store and the N11 marketplace for simple products.

Note: This plugin is developed by BRKSoft and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to N11.com in any way. N11 is a trademark of Doğan Online.

Features

  • Stock Synchronization: Synchronize stock information between WooCommerce and N11.
  • Price Synchronization: Synchronize price information between WooCommerce and N11.
  • Automatic Synchronization: Automatic synchronization via CRON – hourly, twice daily, or daily.
  • Manual Synchronization: One-click instant synchronization.
  • Bidirectional: From WooCommerce to N11 or from N11 to WooCommerce.
  • Automatic SKU Matching: WooCommerce SKU values are automatically matched with N11 Seller Stock Code.

How It Works

  1. Get API Key and Secret from N11 Seller Panel.
  2. Enter API information in the plugin settings and test the connection.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce product SKUs match the Seller Stock Code in N11.
  4. Enable automatic synchronization or use manual buttons.

Premium Version

For more features, get the Premium version:

  • Variable product support
  • Order import from N11
  • Product upload to N11
  • Category mapping
  • Bulk operations with Excel
  • Priority support

External Services

This plugin connects to the N11 marketplace API to synchronize product stock and price information between your WooCommerce store and N11.

What data is sent and when

  • API Credentials: Your N11 API Key (appkey) and API Secret (appsecret) are sent with every API request for authentication.
  • Product Information: When synchronizing from WooCommerce to N11, the plugin sends product SKU (stock code), stock quantity, and price information.
  • Automatic Sync: If enabled, data is sent automatically at the configured interval (hourly, twice daily, or daily).
  • Manual Sync: Data is sent when you click the manual synchronization buttons.
  • Connection Test: When testing the connection, a request is made to retrieve your product list from N11.

Service Provider

This plugin uses the N11 REST API service provided by:

  • Service: N11 Marketplace API
  • Provider: Doğan Online (N11.com)
  • API Base URL: https://api.n11.com
  • Terms of Service: https://www.n11.com/kullanici-sozlesmesi
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.n11.com/gizlilik-politikasi
  • Seller Integration Support: sellerintegration@n11.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin from the WordPress plugin directory or upload the ZIP file.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins page.
  3. Go to the “N11” tab in the WordPress menu.
  4. Enter your N11 API credentials and save.
  5. Test the connection.
  6. Enable automatic synchronization or use manual buttons.
sections.faq:
Where can I get API credentials?

You can get them from N11 Seller Panel > My Account > API Information.

Does it support variable products?

This free version only supports simple products. For variable products, you need to get the Premium version.

How does SKU matching work?

The product SKU value in WooCommerce is compared with the “Seller Stock Code” (stockCode) in N11. Products with the same value are matched.

How does automatic synchronization work?

Using the WordPress CRON system, stock and/or price information of simple products in WooCommerce is automatically sent to N11 at specified intervals (hourly, twice daily, or daily).

Can I synchronize only stock or only price?

Yes, you can select stock and price separately in both automatic and manual synchronization.
